opportunities.name: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme (SISFS)
opportunities.provider: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT), Govt. of India
opportunities.description: Financial assistance to startups for proof of concept, prototype development, product trials, market entry, and commercialization through approved incubators across India.
eligibilityRequirements: DPIIT recognized startup
Incorporated not more than 2 years ago at the time of application
Must have a business idea to develop a product or service with a market fit, viable commercialization scope, and scope of scaling
Startup should not have received more than ₹10 Lakhs of monetary support under any other Central or State Government scheme
benefits: Up to ₹20 Lakhs grant for validation of Proof of Concept, prototype development, or product trials
Up to ₹50 Lakhs of investment through convertible debentures or debt for market entry and scaling
Mentorship and incubation support through top national incubators
requiredDocuments: Audited Balance Sheet or Bank Statements

opportunities.name: Biotechnology Ignition Grant (BIG Scheme)
opportunities.provider: Biotechnology Industry Research Assistance Council (BIRAC), Dept of Biotechnology
opportunities.description: Flagship grant program fostering early-stage biotech, medtech, diagnostics, and digital healthcare innovations with high commercialization potential.
eligibilityRequirements: Registered Indian company with minimum 51% shareholding by Indian citizens
Company age less than 5 years
Project proposal must possess clear medical or biotechnological novelty and proof-of-concept focus
Applicant must have registered with a BIRAC BIG Partner incubator
benefits: Mentorship by clinicians, biotech leaders, and regulatory experts
Access to specialized instrumentation labs and testbeds
requiredDocuments: Detailed R&D Project Proposal with Gantt Chart
Preliminary Concordance or Lab Validation Data

opportunities.name: MeitY TIDE 2.0 (Technology Incubation & Development)
opportunities.provider: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), Startup Hub
opportunities.description: Scheme promoting tech entrepreneurship through financial and technical support to incubators engaged in supporting ICT startups using emerging technologies like IoT, AI, BlockChain, and Robotics.
eligibilityRequirements: Working on emerging technology (AI, Machine Learning, IoT, Data Science)
Early stage with scalable technology architecture
Must incubate physically or virtually with an empaneled G1/G2 TIDE center
benefits: Grant-in-Aid for prototype development up to ₹7 Lakhs
Scale-up funding support up to ₹40 Lakhs through TIDE 2.0 centers
opportunities.applicationDeadline: Rolling admissions via MeitY Startup Hub
requiredDocuments: Budget breakdown with fund utilization plan

opportunities.name: NIDHI-PRAYAS (Promoting and Accelerating Young and Aspiring Innovators)
opportunities.provider: Department of Science & Technology (DST), Govt. of India
opportunities.description: Support from Idea-to-Prototype for young innovators. Provides prototype grant funding to address the gap between idea validation and prototype development.
eligibilityRequirements: Individual innovators or startups registered within 3 years
Focus on physical prototype or tangible hardware/software integration
Ownership of intellectual property by Indian promoters
benefits: Up to ₹10 Lakhs prototype development grant
Access to PRAYAS Shala (maker-labs & rapid fabrication facilities)
Technical mentorship from university research professors
requiredDocuments: Prototype Design Schematics and Bill of Materials (BOM)
Patent search or prior art clearance report

opportunities.name: IndiaAI Mission - GPU Compute & Innovation Vouchers
opportunities.provider: IndiaAI / Digital India Corporation (DIC), Govt. of India
opportunities.description: National AI initiative granting subsidized access to 10,000+ AI compute GPUs, foundational model testbeds, and direct innovation grants for Indian sovereign AI builders.
eligibilityRequirements: Indian registered entity or academic spin-off
Utilizing deep neural network training or high-throughput inference
Compliance with Responsible AI guidelines and data residency inside India
benefits: Up to ₹25 Lakhs equivalent in subsidized cloud GPU compute credits
Access to curated national public health and Indic multimodal datasets
Fast-track integration with National Digital Health Mission (ABDM) sandbox
requiredDocuments: Compute workload sizing estimation (TFLOPS / GPU Hours)

opportunities.name: CIE IIIT Hyderabad MedTech & AI Accelerator
opportunities.provider: Center for Innovation & Entrepreneurship, IIIT Hyderabad
opportunities.description: 6-month intensive accelerator for early-stage DeepTech and HealthTech ventures providing tech research lab access, corporate pilot connects, and ₹25L-₹40L seed capital.
eligibilityRequirements: Strong technical founder or research team
Functional working prototype with measurable benchmark data
Commitment to 6-month structured program milestones
benefits: ₹25 Lakhs initial seed capital with follow-on syndicate access
Direct research mentorship from IIIT-H CVIT / Kohli AI research labs
Pilots with 15+ network hospital chains across Telangana & Karnataka

posts.title: How we signed our first 10 polyclinics without spending on paid ads
posts.content: When we launched PulseAI, we thought cold LinkedIn outreach would work. It didn't. Doctors are busy and rarely check DMs. What actually worked was offering a zero-friction 14-day shadowing trial during evening OPD hours. Here are the 3 key takeaways that changed our sales conversion from 4% to 32%...

posts.title: Navigating DPIIT recognition and Startup India Tax Exemption (80-IAC) in 2026

posts.title: AI Inference Latency vs Cost: Why we shifted from proprietary models to fine-tuned SLMs
posts.content: Sharing our benchmark data comparing proprietary cloud APIs against open weights running on local instances. Saved 68% monthly infra cost while cutting P95 latency to 1.4s.
